data.title: 星熊 · 巨浪拍岸时的单手扛板入海
data.action: 单手轻松将超重型加厚碳纤维冲浪板扛在宽阔健美的肩膀上，赤足大步踏入齐膝白浪，爽朗大笑回望
data.location: 惊涛骇浪卷起数米高巨浪的极限冲浪海滩
data.lighting: 强劲透亮的高明度盛夏阳光照耀着飞溅的碎浪，在古铜微汗的结实腹肌与结实肩背上勾出饱满高光
data.mood: 豪迈不羁、可靠至极与如山岳般让人安心的巨大包容感
data.description: 三米多高的巨型海浪在远海隆隆卷起，其他游客早已纷纷退避，星熊却单手拎着定制的防暴重型冲浪板，大步踏进了翻滚的白色激浪中。墨绿色的及腰长发被海风刮得肆意翻飞，单只鬼角在阳光下威严挺立。她转过身冲岸边站着的你豪爽地挥了挥巨掌，笑声压过了奔涌的浪鸣——「哈哈！这才叫真正的大浪嘛！老陈那家伙说什么也不肯下水，博士，你就在岸边找个阴凉地看好了！等我把前面那道浪头切个粉碎再回来陪你喝酒！」
data.promptProse: Hoshiguma strides fearlessly into rolling white ocean breakers in a forest-green and charcoal athletic bikini with reinforced straps, effortlessly balancing a heavy surfboard across one broad shoulder. Turning back with a roaring, cheerful laugh as sea wind whips her long green hair, she shines under intense summer sunlight and exploding surf.
data.animaCaption: Striding barefoot into knee-deep crashing breakers in a forest-green athletic bikini, she balances a heavy carbon-fiber surfboard effortlessly on one shoulder and turns back with a booming laugh. Bright summer sun catches droplets along her tall, toned shoulders and towering waves.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a forest-green and charcoal athletic two-piece bikini with reinforced elastic straps designed for heavy surf.
